They want to double the fuel. The tool to fill fuel tank: fillFuelTank. We need to know current fuel level. We don\'t have that. We can estimate? We might need to get current fuel level. There\'s no tool to get current fuel level. But we can ask for current fuel level? There\'s no tool. We can assume we can fill up to 50 gallons. Doubling means adding same amount. But we don\'t know current. We could ask user for current fuel. But maybe we can just fill to full? The user wants double. If current is less than 25 gallons, doubling would be less than 50. But we don\'t know. We could ask for current fuel. But the user didn\'t provide. We can respond asking for current fuel level. Or we can assume we can fill to full. But the request is to double.
